# CANDIDATE: BOS_VOLUME_VIX_FILTER_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A bullish break of structure accompanied by above-average volume in a low-VIX environment signals sustained momentum. The edge exists because institutional participation often drives genuine breakouts during low-volatility regimes, and volume confirmation filters out weak or false breaks.

## Mechanism

Entry: When market structure makes a higher high (HH) that breaks the prior swing high (BOS) on the 5-minute chart AND the breaking candle's volume is > 1.6x the 20-period average volume AND VIX < 15, enter long at the close of the breaking candle.  
Exit: Initial stop at the prior swing low that was broken (chart-stop invalidation). Profit target at 2R (twice the risk from entry to stop). Optional runner: after price reaches 1R profit, trail the stop using a 10% chandelier exit (based on ATR or price highs) to capture extended moves.
